change: Final same-profile measurement of the public SIO driver migration and refreshed uninstrumented play bundle.

pin.scope: Shell keyboard bridge plus host pacing only after completed video frames; guest CPU/peripheral timing is unchanged.

peripherals.name: happy-none
peripherals.firmware: built-in high-level model; quiet command only

observer.mode: same binary, EXEC816_LATENCY_TRACE and EXEC816_MASK_TRACE environment gates; replay with both unset

keyboard_input.mode: POKEY matrix scan; PushRawKey/ReleaseRawKey immediate=false; modifier matrix transitions
keyboard_input.initialization: KEY ALL up enables scan mode before modifier changes

measurement_scope.gaps: 18 gaps between the 19 HELLO data sectors 70..88 in one DOS Read; last response byte end to next command start.
measurement_scope.phases: Nonoverlapping elapsed stages within those gaps, including scheduling and interrupts. Inclusive consume includes copy and is not exclusive CPU cost.
measurement_scope.gateway_counts: All matching CPU events in the captured replay log (startup, HELLO, DIR and shutdown), not HELLO-only crossings. S2 comparison uses the same harness and sequence. G4 did not record these fast-path markers.
measurement_scope.exclusion: All completed marked regions in that captured replay: after Forbid returns to before Permit is called, paired by caller DP. IRQ time included; possible rescheduling inside Permit excluded. No nested totals should be added as CPU cost.
measurement_scope.observers: One unchanged diagnostic XEX reused for traced/untraced runs. Both include the same existing load-phase/sector observers; production is built separately without them.
measurement_scope.time_resolution: End-to-end phases sampled in PAL VBI ticks (20 ms); instruction/peripheral intervals use pinned emulator tick time, excluding debugger pauses.

active_gap_investigation.interpretation: The largest active gap is outside the short claim/activation regions; map lookup and block preparation span other Tasks. Same-image replay reproduces it. End-to-end open-to-prompt differs from G4 by one VBI tick; this is not evidence of a material loading regression or a CPU speedup.

play_bundle.banner_dirty_reason: Two pre-existing untracked command-size analysis documents; runtime source inputs match the S3 implementation.
play_bundle.smoke_scope: Disk command loading, physical BREAK during loading, recovery and heap/ownership restoration

reserved_bank_zero_delta.includes: Fixed and per-Task reservations, guards, alignment and unused capacity; upper reservations unchanged.

stack.guard_verdict: intact in all selected native cases and the diagnostic loading smoke
stack.scope: Compiler-emitted routine-local peaks, including outgoing call transfer. Not transitive call-chain or whole-system stack high-water bounds. Waiters now occupy caller stack frames within unchanged guarded reservations.

limits: Development checks only; compiler, full release and physical-hardware qualification remain separate.
The migration is an ownership/lifetime change, not a material loading-speed improvement.
No native serial state machine, disk profile, sector size, compiler pin or HELLO payload change.
The production play bundle has no guest timing probes. Diagnostic timings are not a measurement of its uninstrumented timing.
The previous play bundle is retained; disk cleanup remains separate.
